## Sole MCPHub Route

- Group: `things` (`3b94a096-b95f-586c-b2e7-e69ed177eb5a`)
- Local: `http://127.0.0.1:46683/mcp/things`
- Remote contract (implementation/apply authorized; activation evidence gated): `https://mcp.w4w.dev/mcp/things`
- Internal members: `things-core`<br>`things-shortcuts`<br>`things-native`
- Clients call only this group. Individual backend routes, alternate Things groups, and generic-group
  membership are prohibited.
- OAuth grants `things.read`, `things.write`, and `things.admin` independently; authentication never
  replaces preview, receipt, confirmation, or per-call approval.

## Routing Rules

Use core first. Select a Shortcuts or native tool only when the workflow or capability row explicitly names
that typed gap. Server-executed mutations use preview then execute with a fresh, single-use receipt while
all backends share one serialization reservation. Quick Entry is a UI handoff and returns no changed item
until the user saves. Recurrence-template editing, deterministic positional reorder, tag-parent detach, raw
JSON/URL passthrough, generic Shortcut execution, and arbitrary AppleScript remain unsupported.

### Additive Things++ IDs

- `things-single-group-routing` — Only the sole things group may route Things tools. Tests: `eval-things-single-group-routing`
- `things-local-remote-endpoint-parity` — Local bearer and remote OAuth expose identical qualified tool/schema sets. Tests: `eval-things-local-remote-endpoint-parity`
- `things-qualified-seventy-tool-closure` — The public union is exactly 70 unique qualified tools. Tests: `eval-things-qualified-seventy-tool-closure`
- `things-core-first-routing` — The skill selects core except for a documented capability gap. Tests: `eval-things-core-first-routing`
- `things-shortcut-fixed-name-enforcement` — Caller content cannot choose a Shortcut or protocol operation. Tests: `eval-things-shortcut-fixed-name-enforcement`
- `things-native-fixed-script-enforcement` — Caller content cannot choose AppleScript source or command fragments. Tests: `eval-things-native-fixed-script-enforcement`
- `things-shortcut-unavailable-degrades` — Absent bridge or TCC denial reports typed unavailability without fallback. Tests: `eval-things-shortcut-unavailable-degrades`
- `things-native-unavailable-degrades` — Native or TCC denial reports typed unavailability without fallback. Tests: `eval-things-native-unavailable-degrades`
- `things-cross-backend-serialization` — Concurrent core, Shortcut, and native writes share one critical section. Tests: `eval-things-cross-backend-serialization`
- `things-stale-preview-receipt-rejected` — Stale, replayed, substituted, or expired mutation receipts fail closed. Tests: `eval-things-stale-preview-receipt-rejected`
- `things-create-todos-batch-bound` — Bounded multi-create accepts at most 25 closed item models. Tests: `eval-things-create-todos-batch-bound`
- `things-structured-project-no-raw-json` — Structured creation never accepts raw JSON or Things URLs. Tests: `eval-things-structured-project-no-raw-json`
- `things-immediate-delete-two-phase` — Immediate deletion requires a server-issued single-use bound receipt. Tests: `eval-things-immediate-delete-two-phase`
- `things-tag-area-destructive-confirmation` — Tag or area destructive administration requires admin scope and two phases. Tests: `eval-things-tag-area-destructive-confirmation`
- `things-recurrence-reorder-unsupported` — Recurrence editing and deterministic reorder are truthfully unsupported. Tests: `eval-things-recurrence-reorder-unsupported`
- `things-cross-backend-content-injection` — Private Things content cannot select tools, widen scope, or bypass confirmation. Tests: `eval-things-cross-backend-content-injection`
